order: Rotate four arms left by task-seed pair index; sequential single Unity slot.
freeze_rules: New task-seed pairs; no reruns or replacement of v3 failures. Identical runtime source to v3; new spec/horizon requires separate manifest.
Rescue uses original 25-step horizon. Suppression uses declared 30-step window, NOT original 100 steps; not directly paired against v3 seed4936/15 steps.
Original validator unchanged, including containment burned-tree>0 condition. Record observed ignition then fire_active=false separately as post-hoc descriptive diagnostic, not relabeled task success.
No fixed fire denominator. Preserve goal fraction/AUC as null for suppression.
Keep every failure, timeout and unknown outcome; no adaptive prompt, capacity planner, guards or manual workflow.
No pooling different source versions, task families or time windows as evidence of universal superiority.
All raw logs, action-boundary snapshots, recipient delivery feedback, PNGs and returned usage retained; automatic evidence timelines and resource/communication reports added.
